label: August 17–23, 2026
intro: It's BICT Fest week! Bangkok's biggest international children's theatre festival opens Thursday August 21 at One Bangkok — 10 countries, 11 shows, and Thor-sized magic. Don't miss it.

activities.title: BICT Fest 2026 — Opening Weekend
activities.location: One Bangkok Park (primary venue) + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre
activities.why: 10th anniversary BICT Fest: 11 interactive performances by artists from 9 countries (South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Belgium, France, UK, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand). Theme: 'Play Attention: Look Who's Growing Up!' Participatory shows designed for kids — Thor won't just watch, he'll be part of the action. Highlights include IYKYK (golf-cart ride through light & shadow worlds by Thai multimedia collective DuckUnit) and Plock! (Belgian contemporary circus where performers paint with their bodies à la Jackson Pollock). Free programmes and support programmes available.
activities.tip: Book at eventpop.me/c/bictfest2026 — free slots go first. Opening weekend has the most energy. Wear comfortable shoes; shows may move between outdoor spaces at One Bangkok Park.

activities.title: Toob North at Cloud 11 — Final Stretch
activities.date: Through August 30 — this is your last chance
activities.price: Free to browse; workshops priced individually
activities.why: Toob North closes August 30 — only two full weekends left. If Thor hasn't tried a clay or craft session with the northern makers yet, this is the week before BICT fills the schedule.
activities.tip: Combine a Saturday morning Toob North session with a BICT Fest afternoon show for an epic dad-and-Thor day.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24
activities.why: A good warm-up activity before or after a BICT Fest show — Emporium is on the Sukhumvit line, easy to pair with One Bangkok (BTS Chong Nonsi area). Thor keeps his rollerblading momentum going.
activities.tip: Sunday morning is quietest. Pair with lunch at Emporium Suites food court for an easy day.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Session
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults + skate rental
activities.why: A quick weekday ice session early in the week before BICT Fest takes over Thursday–Sunday. Quiet, cheap, and a great way to keep Thor's ice skills sharp.
activities.tip: Monday–Wednesday slots at Sub-Zero are the emptiest of the week. Treat it as a quick 90-minute outing.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.date: Any day — book ahead on Klook
activities.location: Mega Bangna (BTS On Nut + Grab, ~30 min)
activities.why: If you haven't done the Marvel Experience yet, a weekday early in this week is your window before BICT Fest takes over the weekend. Iron Man, 4D dome, VR flight — Thor will be talking about it for weeks.
activities.tip: Mid-week (Tuesday/Wednesday) at Mega Bangna is quietest. Book on Klook for the best price.
